Introduction. Turnips are crops grown from Turnip seeds, which can only be found in the Swamp biome by picking the naturally growing clusters of yellow flowers. Unlike other farmable flora, they cannot be consumed raw by the player.

Availability. • Turnips are grown by planting Turnip seeds with the Cultivator.
• It takes between 4000s and 5000s (between 66m40s and 83m20s, or about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for them to fully grow.
• Cannot be grown in the Mountain biome.

• Jack-o-turnip
